name: Jotform
label: Jotform — forms, submissions, reports
description: Official Jotform REST API v1. Handler: OfficialApiNode. api_key sent as header APIKEY (never apiKey on the query string). Config host selects the official API hostname (api.jotform.com / eu-api.jotform.com / hipaa-api.jotform.com) and is substituted into baseUrl as https://{host}. Keys are region-bound. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event), not POST /form/{id}/webhooks. Submissions are respondent PII. Customer owns the Jotform account. Never log api_key or answers.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: form_id / submission_id and list filters (offset, limit, filter, orderby). trigger.listen does not call HTTP — register the StudioQuack ingress URL in Jotform (HTTPS). Do not put api_key here. Example: {"operation":"form.get","form_id":"…"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT: form.list | form.get | submission.list | submission.get | submission.delete | report.list | trigger.listen.

schema.label: form_id
schema.description: Form id for form.get, submission.list, report.list. Example: 241234567890123.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: List limit for form.list / submission.list. Example: 20.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: JSON filter for form.list / submission.list. Example: {"created_at:gt":"2026-01-01"}.

schema.label: orderby
schema.description: Order field for form.list / submission.list. Example: created_at.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (Jotform content envelope). trigger.listen: BPMN message event. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Jotform API key. Sent only as header APIKEY. Never query-string. Never log. Jotform API settings.

configurationParameters.label: Host
configurationParameters.description: Official Jotform API hostname. Substituted into baseUrl as https://{host}. US api.jotform.com; EU eu-api.jotform.com; HIPAA hipaa-api.jotform.com. Keys are region-bound.
